description: Compuertas de vaciado. Ayuntamiento de Pamplona / Iruñeko Udala is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Foral de Navarra. Location and information of the drainage gates for irrigation that the City of Pamplona has available. Coverage: Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The portal shows the English title as "Emptying gates. Pamplona City Council / Iruñeko Udala" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Foral de Navarra. Its keywords include AyuntamientoPamplona, Dataset público con descarga disponible, IruñekoUdala, GeoPamplona. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2026-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
